name: authoring-guessed-scope-step-rejected
description: Guessed scope access: a follow-up request reads the issue number from a step id the author guessed (scope.issues) instead of the step that exists (list_issues). validate_draft refuses the draft with a finding on that step's url naming the unknown step, and edit_workflow_patch refuses to introduce the guessed reference, leaving the draft unchanged. The same request against the real step id passes. validate_draft runs without a database; no live HTTP.
failure_class: draft reads scope from a guessed step id and fails at runtime with placeholder_unresolved
